after.zh: 和参照比差异，比看绝对亮度可靠得多。这就是背景减除。
after.en: Comparing against a reference is far more reliable than looking at absolute brightness. This is background subtraction.

t.zh: 商店监控、路口车流统计、停车场的空位提示，常要回答同一个问题：画面里多了什么？摄像头不动，背景几乎不变，变的只是闯进来的东西。
t.en: Shop security cameras, traffic counters at junctions and free-space signs in car parks often have to answer the same question: what is new in the picture? The camera does not move and the background barely changes; the only thing that changes is whatever comes in.

t.zh: 这一关有两个输入：「现场」是现在拍的，「空场」是没人时拍的参照。输出是一张只有 0 和 1 的图，叫掩膜：1 标出闯入者占的格子，其余是 0。
t.en: This level has two inputs: "Scene" is taken now, and "Empty scene" is a reference taken when nobody was there. The output is an image of only 0s and 1s, called a mask: 1 marks the cells the intruder covers, and everything else is 0.

t.zh: 这是第一关有两张输入图。新元件<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>把两张图逐格相减、相加：a − b 的每一格，就是 a 的这一格减去 b 的这一格。
t.en: This is the first level with two input pictures. The new parts <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> subtract and add two pictures cell by cell: each cell of a − b is that cell of a minus that cell of b.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：四组测试里，闯入者的位置各不相同。输出要把它圈出来，一格不多，一格不少。
t.en: Your task in this level: the intruder is in a different place in each of the four tests. Your output must mark it out exactly, not one cell more or less.

caption.zh: 第一组：现场、空场和期望的掩膜
caption.en: Set 1: scene, empty scene and the expected mask

brief.zh: 「现场」比「空场」多了一个东西。只在它所在的格子输出 1，其余输出 0。
brief.en: The "Scene" has one thing more than the "Empty scene". Output 1 only in the cells it covers, and 0 everywhere else.

hint.zh: 光照不均时，单看亮不亮会误判。先比一比两张图哪里不一样。
hint.en: With uneven lighting, judging by brightness alone goes wrong. First compare where the two images differ.
